head: codex/5613-terminal-projection-repair
title: [v0.91.8][csdlc-v2][closeout] Reconcile stranded terminal projections atomically
body:
Closes #5613

Adds one narrow typed terminal SOR validation-result repair with exact authority, target, receipt, and old-result CAS. It reuses the existing journaled projection/receipt transaction and proves rollback under injected interruption.

Reconciles the proven closed-out projections for #5337, #5339, #5358, #5591, and #5602 from their retained receipts while preserving original PR identities. #5591 current SOR validation paths are portable; append-only audit provenance remains unchanged; unsupported guardian-soak JSON is absent.

Focused terminal repair tests, public schema contract, strict all-target Clippy, terminal projection proof, exact scope proof, and fresh-checkout proof pass. Exact bounded review found zero blockers. No Runtime v2, ADL-v2, AWS, CI, or #5615 scope is included.
